name: Iridescent Pearl
description: Pearl white with violet and teal accents. Light only.

provenance.attribution: Keyur Golani, for the keyurgolani.name portfolio platform.
provenance.derivation: anchor-v2 from the reviewed prototype's iridescent-pearl anchors. It puts the light accent #8a70d6 back to #8c72d9 and secondary #438d95 back to #4caeb3, undoing PR 2a's nudges: anchor-v2 solves the signature fill itself. adjustments lists the 11 roles it moves from anchor-v1.

fallbacks: Every display mode renders the light set, high contrast renders the set high-contrast-v2 derives from it, and print renders the light set.
caveats: Light only: it keeps its native light mode, so dark isn't offered with it.
In light mode the secondary is darkened to #438d95 so the signature fill reaches 3:1, so the teal reads muted.
